blocks.orig: Ngorongoro Coffee Lodge is situated between Rhotia and Karatu, surrounded by coffee plantations and forest views, and conveniently positioned for trips to the Ngorongoro Crater and Lake Manyara National Park. The lodge features 26 cottages, including family suites that accommodate larger groups. Each cottage is well-equipped with hand-crafted furniture, a comfortable bed, a sitting area, a fireplace for cooler evenings, and a private veranda to enjoy the views of the Ngorongoro Forest. The bathrooms boast an indoor and outdoor shower, allowing the surrounding nature into your room. After a day of driving, you can relax in the common area, enjoy Wi-Fi, unwind in the lounge, or have a drink by the pool!
blocks.html: Ngorongoro Coffee Lodge lies between Rhotia and Karatu, with coffee plantations and forest views all around, and is well placed for visits to the Ngorongoro Crater and Lake Manyara National Park. There are 26 cottages, among them family suites for larger groups. Every cottage has handmade furniture, a comfortable bed, a seating area, a fireplace for chilly evenings and a private veranda with views of the Ngorongoro Forest. The bathrooms have both an indoor and an outdoor shower, bringing the surrounding nature into your room. After a day on the road you can unwind in the shared area, use the Wi-Fi, relax in the lounge or have a drink by the pool!
